steps.label: lookdev
steps.run: cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/esp/"* . && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b -P lookdev.py > bl.log 2>&1; grep -a 'LOOKDEV DONE' bl.log || tail -20 bl.log; a="ld.json esp/ld/ld.json"; for f in ld/*.jpg; do a="$a $f esp/ld/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
